subject: Connected source-edition migration and current-source package integration
claim: The connected 394 Project 4 manifests and 593 edition-1 sources pass native admission on both hosts, with a focused recheck after the final runner repair. The selected six package workflows and the 40-case production-admission owner execute successfully on Windows and Debian. Compiler reconstruction produces identical analyzer/emitter WVB through two fresh generations; compiler-scale verification uses the existing Profile 7. This record does not qualify every repository owner or promote installed artifacts.

source.value: Base commit 992ba7bbebbbf3356966bdcc0ea1d2b0e5923720 plus pending source changes. Final connected input identity: 991 files, 12271243 payload bytes, SHA-256 a39c1beec1fcfba2395e4b77c1d95d5207e5c6e7677963845d78e22901611f56. Derive the set from every tracked Project 4 manifest under Projects, every declared root/source/source-input-lock/source-profile/target-descriptor path, and Windvale.wvws. Sort distinct repository-relative ASCII paths; concatenate UTF-8 records path + NUL + canonical decimal byte length + NUL + lowercase payload SHA-256 + LF. The derived record stream is 130680 bytes. It is a reproducible digest definition, not a retained artifact file.

limitations: Full Windows admission aggregate was 9b6c79e2334407ccd5663e196e56f19760f1cd6f349be80e0b11165c862f5818; full Debian aggregate was 505d2f8ed9a37b3c390bdcbecfed742608592ca5cb0d80e08fc92867c163e614. These aggregates include host-specific producers and the then-loaded audit script, so they are not cross-host byte-equality claims. Final two-project rechecks: Windows a448f22d68381392b657920ee70f3a791a8598243961155a5d50fc8f358955ad; Debian ac40c76f9b74a0e6e248cfbc42390ff414c61606b4f8d531fe989aac8298bfbb.

Recorded predecessor source is commit 992ba7bbebbbf3356966bdcc0ea1d2b0e5923720, tree c6231310843c24a03b0253f6f5a062d77db9f73f. Its checked inventory has 5111 files and 600259818 bytes. Both hosts constructed predecessor/current products through existing qualified WVB pins; valid native intermediates were reused. This is not a claim of an empty-cache bootstrap at every stage.

Current compiler keys: Windows cc9a60c5ef462f0ca46f868bb27cf1ddbacbcfb52f1361d90a0909f42128ff67 during package/convergence work, then a521fceac4b0230f631139a41c4d056baf745bb2031c5db1aa2dada99f9b1837 after normalizing the Windows packager to required CRLF; Debian 6ef8328a4c182c4af0a9767a0cd433294e8401b3d3768ebe9c6e4f37c71ef6e1. Windows rebuilding after normalization preserved exact native compiler product identities.

The first Windows convergence invocation exhausted the Profile-2 verifier after completing both fresh generations. Identical retained WVBs passed separately under Profile 7; the failed invocation is not relabeled as a successful complete run. The Linux gate completed all thirteen phases. Afterward, its rejection check was tightened to require exit 1 and a semantic-invalid diagnostic, and internal identifiers were mechanically renamed. The malformed native rejection was separately confirmed on Windows and Debian; unchanged generations were not rebuilt for that guard change.

All six compiler/admission WVB identities match across hosts. Native Windows and Linux executable bytes are intentionally host-specific. Current lowerer WVB is 1309723 bytes, bd153e4cd06db4fb66fabf769119ff423400cb5968de8f17215f2462f7239251; Windows lowerer fdf426428b3617de1f22e333316645ac100f1918aae8efe1e5995934e1b6b992 and Linux lowerer a37fa4fe4ac08856f48577f44298a2173cf83f024bea79a48ddde59177aa764a.

Historical application package locks, bootstrap pins, and shipped browser artifacts remain unchanged. The recorded browser output is 919577 bytes, 2bf84dc2a8cbb80c52ec7fb6cb2e29eef27def1707f398a276c61063d73df06e. Locked WVDB output is 26145 bytes, 77cb6034402942734be316b9a135d6c1b46ace5cb43a198b2aafe2d1b098027b.

The changed-file plan was inspected and not mechanically executed: it selected 82 owners with 17970 expected seconds, including broad OS/storage/legacy reconstruction beyond the selected package and compiler claims. No full repository qualification, GitHub CI result, arbitrary unit/never native lowering, Seed removal, installed promotion, full Libraries 1.0 completion, release, independent human review, or measured peak-memory claim is made.

Earlier production-admission attempts exposed the runner unit-return lowering boundary. The repaired private diagnostic helper returns its existing failure code directly to all three callers; the final full owner passes 24 ingress and 16 Project 4 cases on each host. Native acceptance and resource bounds were not widened. General unit/never native lowering remains outside this delivery.
